verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents an app directory or marketplace from which a team-admin can browse and install prebuilt integrations. The 'Publish your agents or apps in Teams' item is only a developer-publishing heading. Graph's ability to configure a team with apps is a developer building block, and Connectors are an adjacent notification feature, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can install prebuilt integrations from an app directory or marketplace
